NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (Part 2) (Second Revision) which is identical with ISO 10893-2 : 2011 —Non-destructive testing of steel tubes — Part 2: Automated eddy current testing of seamless and welded (except submerged arc-welded) steel tubes for the detection of imperfectionsâ€™ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Non-destructive Testing Sectional Committee and approval of the Metallurgical Engineering Division Council.
